name: Canvas Backpack
Special Effect: Basic backpack. Water-resistant canvas. Fits snugly.
Description: A simple canvas backpack with two straps and a single main compartment. Functional, nothing special.

name: Leather Backpack
Special Effect: Tough leather construction. Three exterior pockets. Waxed seams keep contents dry.
Description: A well-stitched leather backpack with reinforced bottom. Three external pouches for quick access items.

name: Traveler's Pack
Special Effect: Padded shoulder straps. Sleeping roll straps on bottom. Side water bottle pockets.
Description: Designed for long journeys. Extra padding, multiple compartments, and straps for bedroll and waterskin.

name: Iron-Bound Backpack
Special Effect: Leather reinforced with iron rivets and corner plates. Lockable main compartment (DC 15 lockpick).
Description: A heavy-duty backpack with iron corner brackets, riveted straps, and a small padlock. Bandits will have a hard time cutting this open.

name: Steel Frame Pack
Special Effect: Light steel frame distributes weight evenly. Reduces fatigue on long marches. Detachable day-pack.
Description: A steel-framed backpack used by military scouts. The frame transfers weight to the hips, letting you carry more with less strain.

name: Mithril Pack
Special Effect: Mithril frame weighs almost nothing. Practically indestructible. Foldable to the size of a book.
Description: A masterwork backpack woven with mithril threads around an ultra-light frame. Holds a staggering amount for its size.

name: Adamantine Pack
Special Effect: Adamantine-reinforced. Immune to slashing damage. Fireproof. Can be used as an improvised shield (AC +1 when worn on back).
Description: An adamantine-threaded backpack that could survive a dragon's breath. Dwarven mastercraft at its finest.

name: Titanium Expedition Pack
Special Effect: Military-grade titanium frame. Climate-controlled compartments. Integrated camelback. Emergency beacon (once, range 50 miles).
Description: Built for extreme expeditions. Arctic, desert, or jungle — this pack handles it all. Used by elite royal surveyors.

name: Dragonhide Pack
Special Effect: Made from adult dragon hide. Resistant to all elemental damage. Grants fire/cold resistance while worn. The dragon's innate magic reinforces the stitching.
Description: Crafted from the hide of a mature dragon, this pack is impossibly tough yet supple. The scales shimmer with residual elemental energy.

name: Orcish War Pack
Special Effect: Massive hide pack. Can hold a second weapon across the back. Trophy hooks for displaying kills. Intimidating appearance (+1 Intimidate).
Description: A brutalist pack made from cave bear hide, studded with bone and brass. Hooks and loops let you carry extra weapons and trophies.

name: Gnomish Contraption Pack
Special Effect: Built-in pulley system for heavy loads. Retractable umbrella. Small clockwork mechanism that organizes contents. May malfunction on a natural 1.
Description: A gnomish invention with gears, levers, and a small steam valve. Press a button and the pack organizes itself. Usually.

name: Elven Leaf-Weave Pack
Special Effect: Woven from enchanted sylvan leaves. Nearly weightless. Camouflages with forest surroundings (+2 Stealth in nature). Repairs itself over time.
Description: An elven-crafted pack made from strangled leaves treated with moondew. It weighs nothing on your back and blends into the forest.

name: Dwarven Mining Pack
Special Effect: Built-in pickaxe loop, lantern hook, and ore sample pouches. Reinforced bottom for setting down on rough stone. Resistant to heat.
Description: A dwarven standard-issue mining pack. Holds enough supplies for a week underground. Every strap and buckle serves a purpose.

name: Merchant's Inventory Satchel
Special Effect: Multiple organized compartments with labeled tabs. Small ledger book included. Coin pouch integrated into the flap.
Description: A merchant's satchel with dividers, small pouches, and a wax tablet for tallying. Everything has its place.

name: Battle Wizard's Haversack
Special Effect: Warded with minor magic. Spell component pockets organized by school. Quick-draw scroll case (holds 5 scrolls, retrieve as free action).
Description: A military-issue wizard's pack with anti-tamper wards and organized component pouches. The scroll case along the spine lets you snap a scroll into your hand.

name: Nomad's Saddlebag Set
Special Effect: Pair of saddlebags with quick-release buckles. Weatherproof. Can be worn as a satchel or mounted on a horse/mount.
Description: A set of two leather saddlebags connected by a sturdy belt. Equally at home on a horse or over your shoulder.

name: Treasure Hauler's Frame
Special Effect: A wooden A-frame with rope netting. No frills — just raw carrying capacity. Slow movement while equipped (-10 speed). Requires STR 12.
Description: A porter's frame used by dockworkers and treasure hunters. It's ugly, heavy, and uncomfortable, but you can carry a small dragon's hoard with it.
